channels.intro: Connections go through each network's official API. Our backend keeps the access tokens; nobody pays a middleman.
channels.privateOnly: Posts land as private until the network approves our app.
channels.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect {{- name}}? Its scheduled posts will fail until it is connected again.
channels.loadError: The channels could not be loaded.
channels.secretHint: Bluesky → Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords. Never the main password.
channels.overviewHint: What is connected for each of our sites.
channels.notConfigured: Not set up on the server

automation.intro: An automation key lets a scheduled Claude task (or any script) prepare posts through the API. With "Drafts only" a person still publishes every post from the admin.
automation.name: Name
automation.draftsOnlyHint: The key can only create drafts; publishing stays with us. Recommended until the posts are trusted.
automation.confirmRevoke: Revoke the key {{- name}}? Anything using it stops working at once.
automation.loadError: The keys could not be loaded.
automation.secretHint: It is shown only this once. Keep it as a secret of the scheduled task, never in a repository.
automation.copyFailed: Copying failed: select the text and copy it by hand.
automation.apiHint: Header X-Api-Key; JSON in and out.
automation.epAccounts: the connected channels and their ids
automation.epMedia: a file, or {"url": …} that our backend downloads
automation.epPosts: a post: text, media, channels (accountIds or platforms), optional text per platform, optional schedule
automation.epList: posts in a period, so the automation does not repeat itself
automation.dailyHint: A scheduled Claude task runs every morning and prepares the day's post:
automation.daily1: picks a boat, destination or offer from our sites and checks the last posts so it does not repeat
automation.daily2: writes the text in our voice, a shorter one for X and Bluesky, hashtags for Instagram and TikTok
automation.daily3: takes our own photos of that boat (Boats · Media) and sends the post through this API
automation.daily4: with a drafts-only key it waits for us: we approve it here in Posts with one click

sites.pick: Which site is this channel for?
sites.pickHint: Each site has its own Facebook, Instagram and TikTok; YouTube is one for all sites.

ai.intro: Every morning the AI picks a boat from the site's own fleet that was not featured lately, takes our photos of it, writes a text for each network and prepares the post. With approval on, it waits for you in Posts as a draft; otherwise it is scheduled by itself.
ai.noAi: The AI key is missing on the server (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY): daily posts cannot run.
ai.timeHint: Europe/Zagreb; the AI prepares it 3 hours earlier.
ai.approvalHint: Off: the AI schedules the post by itself.
ai.videoHint: A vertical video of the boat: Reel on Facebook and Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts. Facebook and Instagram also keep the photo post, the Reel follows 3 hours later.
ai.guidancePlaceholder: e.g. push early booking for 2027; no gulets; mention Kornati and Vis.
ai.started: The AI is making today's post; it shows up in the list below in a few minutes.
ai.loadError: The AI settings could not be loaded.
ai.ownReel: Video is made on our server from the boat’s photos (no outside service). With Higgsfield keys it becomes an AI video.
ai.noVideo: Video cannot be made on the server yet (ffmpeg is not installed): posts use photos only.
